title: Add to a date
summary: Add months and days to an ISO date.

sections.use: Work out a due date: an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) plus a number of months and days, either may be negative.
sections.exclusions: No times or time zones. Years and weeks are not inputs; use 12 months or 7 days.
sections.limitations: Months are added first; a day past the month's end is moved back to its last day and clamped is true. Years 1 to 9999.
sections.missing_data: Use 0 for months or days you do not need.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.months: Whole months to add (negative to subtract).
inputs.days: Whole days to add (negative to subtract).

outputs.out: The new date and whether it was clamped.
